- Defender for Endpoint (CVE-2022-37971)
- SentinelOne EDR

T
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Windows Anitivirus and EDR Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
  | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
  | where FileName endswith "ndis.sys"
  | where FolderPath startswith "C:\\temp\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\"
